_comment: Configuration for automated mesh convergence study
_doc: This config will be used to generate THREE meshes automatically (coarse/medium/fine)

case_info.description: Mesh convergence study with steady inlet for grid-independent solution validation

physics._comment: Use laminar for faster convergence. RANS/LES supported but slower.

numerics._comment: REQUIRED: Use 'accurate' or 'precise' for convergence studies (consistent 2nd-order schemes)

mesh._comment: NOTE: mesh.cells_per_diameter will be OVERRIDDEN by convergence study
mesh._auto_generated: Three meshes will be created: coarse (10), medium (14), fine (20) cpd

boundary_layers._comment: Keep boundary layer settings CONSISTENT across all meshes

surface_refinement._comment: Consistent refinement strategy across all meshes

boundary_conditions._comment: These BCs will be converted to STEADY STATE for pure mesh convergence

inlet._comment: Steady inlet: 5 L/min cardiac output. Time-varying inlet will be auto-converted to steady.

outlets._comment: Fixed pressure outlets (mmHg) for mesh convergence. Windkessel not recommended for pure convergence.

computational._comment: Parallel meshing and solving for faster convergence study

simulation_control._comment: Run 10 cardiac cycles to ensure quasi-steady state convergence

convergence_study_settings._comment_base: Coarsest mesh resolution. Medium=14, Fine=20 (with r=√2)
convergence_study_settings._comment_mapfields: Map solution from coarse→medium→fine for faster convergence
